26. ISP — Interface Segregation
Principle

SIMPLE ENGLISH
Clients should not be forced to depend on operations they do not use. Prefer cohesive,
client-specific interfaces.
සිංහJලෙන් Printer එකට scan කරන්න බුරි නම් Scanner method එක implement කරන්න බල කරන්න එපා.
A basic printer prints; a multifunction device also scans.

Fat interface · Focused interfaces · print + scan Basic printer forced to scan · Printable Scannable · Read the diagram: Compare the responsibilities or tradeoffs in each group. · Jකාටස් JදJක් Jවනස සසඳන්න.
Expected result: BasicPrinter has no unused or misleading scan operation.

Q: How is ISP different from SRP?
A: ISP focuses on client interface dependencies; SRP focuses on a module's reasons to change.
